scope.conditional_verifier: independent edge-fixed DP and within-group Bernoulli enumeration

limitations: ESS is not independently recomputed; saved masks, ranges, screens and raw-scale MCSE identities are checked.
ADMM residuals and first-hit stopping times are checked logically, not reconstructed from solver trajectories.
Stored communities and edge uniforms rebuild P/A/Y; no scientific samples or fits are added or selected.
Unless verify_rng is enabled, stored generation draws are not independently reconstructed from their seeds.
Scalar likelihood/count residuals are recomputed at four retained positions per chain; all scalar draws enter diagnostic checks.
CSV presentation and numerical review-flag selection are not independently regenerated.
